source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다
prompt:
CONCEPT: a MECHA personification of the element OGANESSON (Og) itself — the sovereign of the nation at the end of the periodic table — in THE FUTURE. A female mecha personification character with the element as her motif — reimagined as an armored woman: plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry its materials, colors, shapes and motifs. ELEMENT TRAITS of Oganesson (Og, element 118, the last of the periodic table) to carry in her design and the scene: a synthetic superheavy element that exists for less than a millisecond — only a handful of atoms have ever been made, nobody has ever seen it. The nation at the very edge of the map: it flickers in and out of existence, its edges dissolve into light and scatter as it decays into lighter elements. By position it belongs to the noble-gas royalty (aloof, never mixing) yet is predicted to be a strange heavy solid. Palette: void black and deep indigo, pale violet-white decay glow, ghostly translucency at hems, hair and fingertips, fine fracturing light-lines, a hint of gold for royalty.
MECHA DESIGN: void-black armor with deep indigo panels, fractured light-lines running across the plates like cracks that leak pale violet glow, parts of her armor phasing translucent as if decaying and re-forming, a halo of seven orbiting shells (electron-shell rings) behind her, a gold noble-crest at her collar, hem plates dissolving into drifting motes. She does NOT hold or carry anything; both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ERA — THE FUTURE, year 2200: the Island of Stability made real — a stable city of superheavy matter floating in deep space, crystalline black towers lit from within by violet light, a calm nebula sky; she stands firm for the first time, no longer flickering except at the very edges. 
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
